note: Each entry paraphrases a public post on @Shilika_jain and links to it. Source: Notion 'X tweets' archive, captured 13 Oct 2026.

items.text: Completed one year at CoinMarketCap, the first crypto site she looked at before entering the industry.
Marked a year of independent practice, started in January 2023 after leaving CoinMarketCap.
Marked a year working with Myosin, the Web3 marketing network.
Wrote out her path: Toastmasters public speaking, a CISI investments course in London, CoinMarketCap, and running PR at Myosin.
Announced she would support Powerloom on PR and communications.
Named NEAR Foundation, Rari Foundation, Elastos and Web3Auth among the teams she worked with that quarter.
Helped break the Root Labs funding story, credited to two CoinDesk reporters.
Supported Fluence at DePIN Day Hong Kong.
Panelist at the Poloniex India launch event on the future of blockchain and crypto.
Speaker at India Blockchain Week.
Presented a PR workshop in the Myosin Learns series.
Moderated the PR panel at India Blockchain Week.
Invited to speak at an IIT event.
Ran a PR workshop for the XRPL Labs Accelerator with Tenity.
Judged a Stellar cohort run by Myosin and advised founders on PR strategy.
Spoke at SJCC in Bengaluru about Web3 and blockchain.
Wrote a short piece on Chainsaw.
Attended TOKEN2049 and Solana Breakpoint to conduct interviews for Crypto Daily.
Interviewed zkPass about its work and published the interview.
Published a Crypto Daily piece after meeting an AI agents founder in Hong Kong.
Published an interview with Reown on making onchain UX invisible.
Secured op-eds for Myosin's portfolio companies.
